definitions.explanation: describes an extremely large number or amount of something; so many as to be overwhelming

examples.japanese: {夥|おびただ}しい⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A vast number of stars were visible.
There was an immense amount of blood at the accident scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夥|おびただ}しい⟦{蔵書|ぞうしょ}→蔵書：15479_zousho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The library has a vast collection of books.

notes:
{夥|おびただ}しい describes an overwhelmingly large quantity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {夥|おびただ}しい⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (a vast number of ~)
- {夥|おびただ}しい⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (an immense amount of ~)
- {夥|おびただ}しい⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (enormous damage)

USAGE:
- Literary and formal in tone
- Emphasizes quantity that is beyond normal expectations
- Often used in dramatic or emphatic contexts
- Can describe both positive (stars, books) and negative (blood, casualties) quantities

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧ (enormous, vast)
- ⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧ (enormous - often for money/cost)
- ⟦{無数|むすう}→無数：00300_musuu⟧ (countless)
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧ (many - casual)

WRITING:
The kanji {夥|おびただ}しい is relatively uncommon; the word is often written in hiragana.

REGISTER: Formal/literary. Common in written Japanese and news.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {夥|おびただ}しくなかったら
